9958dcfe79c7dcfa9657bf6710ac6433077bb4fa.summary: Silent Push Threat Team blog (published 2024-10-02) on FIN7, described as a financially motivated group with ties to Russia. FIN7 is said to run at least seven fake 'AI deepnude' generator sites and 'free download' and 'free trial' honeypots that deliver Redline Stealer, D3F@ck Loader and Lumma Stealer. A separate malvertising campaign pushes NetSupport RAT through fake browser-extension pages that lead to .MSIX malware. The report describes SEO tactics and shell websites, and says the sites found were taken offline after takedown requests. Silent Push counts 4,000+ FIN7 domains and IPs.…
